title: Gerunds
content: A gerund (verb + ing) acts like a noun in a sentence. - Seeing is believing. - Running a marathon is not an easy thing to do. - Watching TV is sometimes harmful. - Eating is always fun. - My hobby is painting. - She loves babysitting her sister. - I like listening to music. - I wasted all my afternoon by taking a nap. - I am afraid of singing a song on a stage. Often, a possessive noun or pronoun comes before a gerund. - I hope that you don’t mind my using your pen. - Don’t be mad about my leaving early. - I don’t want you misunderstanding. - You will be amazed by my writing. [Quiz 14.1] Fill in the blanks. 1)I enjoy ______ (draw) as a hobby. 2)She likes ______ (buy) clothes. 3)Children are fond of ______ (play) with water. 4)______ (dance) is my favorite thing to do. 5)I am upset at his ______ (break) the rule. View Answers[14.1] 1) drawing 2) buying 3) playing 4) Dancing 5) breaking
